| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `registerRoute`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `routes.mount`                                                                                                        |
| `registerCapability`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `capabilities.provide`                                                                                                |
| `registerPromptPack`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `prompts.registerPack`                                                                                                |
| `registerQueueJob`, `registerMaintenanceJob`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `jobs.register`                                                                                                       |
| `registerWorker`, `registerEventHandler` (and `emitEvent`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `events.subscribe` (and `events.publish`)                                                                             |

## Manifest v2

Fields: `manifestVersion` (2), `id`, `name`, `version`, `publisher`, `tier`, `hostApi` (all required); `entrypoints.main`, `signature`, `contentHash`, `permissions[]`, `requiredPermissions`, `requires[]` and `optional[]` (capability + semver range), `provides[]` (capability + version), `events.publishes[]` (name + schema file), `events.subscribes`, `audit.actions`, `egress.hosts`, `jobs.types`, `prompts.keys`, `secrets.keys`, `config.schema`, `data.schema`, `data.retention` (`retain`, `archive`, `purge`; required when `database.ownedTables` is non-empty), `database.ownedTables`, `database.readAccess`, `legacyTables[]`, `contributions.mcp`, `extends[]` (declared `ctx.extend` ids), `groups[]`, `resourceTypes[]` (`sensitivity` is `standard`, `confidential`, or `mnpi` and required when the addon owns tables), `ui` (entry file, runtime load, contributions, `slots`), `metadata` (informational only).

`validateManifestV2(manifest, options?)` returns `{ ok, issues }`; each issue has `code`, `path`, `message`, `fix` and `docs`. It runs the schema with Ajv, then the rules a schema cannot express:

- Permissions, job types, prompt keys, published events and audit actions start with `<id>.` or the id with underscores; secret keys start with `<id>:`.
- No duplicate entries; a capability is not both required and optional; every `requiredPermissions` entry is declared.
- Tier 2 cannot declare `legacyTables` or `database.readAccess`, and its owned tables are qualified with `data.schema`, which must be `addon_<id with underscores>`.
- Any non-empty `database.ownedTables` requires `data.retention` (`retain`, `archive`, or `purge`).
- Tier 1 `legacyTables` name owned tables; a rename lands in the addon prefix.
- Package paths stay inside the package; event schemas are `.schema.json` files; runtime-loaded UI has an entry file.
- With `options.reservedNamespaces` (the host's core namespaces), the id must not be one of them.

The function is pure: no file system, network or environment access.
